getPref returns raw value; duplicateTitleThreshold stored85 by defaults, _loadPreferences assigns85 with no division. Fuzzy similarity0.9 does not reach85; changing instance threshold to0.85 yields result with same owned item/cache. Other callers preference overrides unreviewed.

Metadata DOI/ISBN/title matches also return isDuplicate=true even when hash differs; comments say possible duplicate reference/import+review handled by metadata retriever. Actual importer/retriever must be read before treating this as automatic unwanted skip.
